name: 91387 · Canyon Cntry, CA
findings: ZIP 91387 (Canyon Cntry) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91387 (Canyon Cntry) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91387 (Canyon Cntry) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).
